lanterns.speaker: kit
lanterns.text: The redcoats are moving tonight. Mr. Revere needs the signal hung in the Old North Church: one lantern if they march by land, two if they cross the river by boat.

arriving.speaker: sivart
arriving.text: It's almost dawn… they're already here.

first_shot.speaker: senoj
first_shot.text: Stop. Before we go on: who fired that shot?

first_shot.speaker: senoj
first_shot.text: Neither did anyone else, apparently. That's a mystery for later.
